title: 增长的内存泄露
summary: 每秒程序占用当前秒数内存，优先从剩余更多的内存条分配，平局选第一条；首次无法分配时返回时间和两条剩余内存。
insight: 从 time=1 模拟，每次选择较大剩余值并扣 time；若较大值也小于 time 就停止。
pitfalls: 返回的是无法分配的当前秒

solutions.title: 逐秒较大内存优先
solutions.idea: 题目策略确定，直接模拟直到失败。
steps: while max(memory1,memory2)>=time，按 memory1>=memory2 选择并扣 time，time++

code.java: class Solution { public int[] memLeak(int memory1,int memory2){int time=1;while(Math.max(memory1,memory2)>=time){if(memory1>=memory2)memory1-=time;else memory2-=time;time++;}return new int[]{time,memory1,memory2};} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun memLeak(memory1Value:Int,memory2Value:Int):IntArray{var memory1=memory1Value;var memory2=memory2Value;var time=1;while(maxOf(memory1,memory2)>=time){if(memory1>=memory2)memory1-=time else memory2-=time;time++};return intArrayOf(time,memory1,memory2)} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: vector<int> memLeak(int memory1,int memory2){int time=1;while(max(memory1,memory2)>=time){(memory1>=memory2?memory1:memory2)-=time++;}return {time,memory1,memory2};} };
